source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The calendar.properties migration needed followups for a missing calendar-alarms.ftl preferences include and misspelled occurrence prompt resource. Current XHTML references calendar/calendar-occurrence-prompt.ftl exactly. A valid Fluent ID does not help when its file is absent or misspelled at the consumer. Check resource include and installed filename along with ID/arguments when changing localization.
title: Keep exact localized resource filenames and document links paired
